newsitem.title: USA: Porsche to make sport utility vehicle.
newsitem.headline: Porsche to make sport utility vehicle.

text.p: German sports car maker Porsche AG said on Tuesday it plans to enter the sport utility vehicle market.
"It's only a question of time, not the decision. The decision is made," Porsche chairman Wendelin Wiedeking told a news conference at the North American International Auto Show.
He added the company's plan "is to bring this product to the market this century."
Wiedeking said Porsche was talking to a third party about the vehicles but would not say whether Porsche or the third party would make the vehicles. He did not identify the party.
The move into the growing sport utility market is part of Porsche's plan to sell high performance vehicles outside its core sports market segment, he said.
